checks.message: Repository provisional boundary is visibly disclosed and never represented as official; official geometry remains a recalculation trigger.
Three provisional key areas remain clearly labelled and non-authoritative.
All land-use polygons were cut from one shared grid intersected with SITE-001, providing full coverage and shared edges.
Twelve scenario nodes include human review, appeal, pause, and exit; six are testing/validation scenarios and three are landmarks.
Housing units, rents, affordability share, FAR, height, and formal controls remain unknown rather than fabricated.
Chinese and English static HTML use local images and no remote runtime resources.
The bilingual proposal links design judgments to structured geometry, metrics, sources, standards, assumptions, and design-depth evidence.
Chinese and English proposal, HTML, figures, and PDFs use paired filenames and aligned content.
